channel.title: The Stream Desk (Streaming Price Check)
channel.description: Streaming price changes, new services and sports rights.

item.title: Walmart raises prices on its onn Google TV streamers by $10
item.description: Walmart's onn Google TV lineup now costs $10 more per device, with the 4K Pro at $69.98 and the Full HD stick at $39.98.

item.title: Five NBA teams moved local games to DAZN this season
item.description: Five NBA teams signed exclusive local streaming deals with DAZN before the 2026-27 season, keeping only some games on over-the-air TV.

item.title: Netflix wins Spanish rights to the 2030 men's World Cup
item.description: Netflix will stream all 104 matches of the 2030 World Cup in Spain. US rights for 2030 and 2034 have not been sold yet.

item.title: Disney+ and Hulu ad-free plans rise to $21.49 a month
item.description: Disney raised its standalone ad-free Disney+ and Hulu plans by $2.50 to $21.49 each; the ad-free Disney+, Hulu bundle went to $21.99.

item.title: Apple TV streaming price rises to $14.99 a month
item.description: Apple raised its Apple TV subscription from $12.99 to $14.99 a month and the annual plan from $99 to $119, effective immediately.

item.title: Peacock raises prices on all three plans
item.description: Peacock Premium went to $12.99, Premium Plus to $19.99 and Select to $8.99, NBCUniversal's fourth Peacock price increase in four years.

item.title: Prime Video's ad-free option becomes Ultra at $4.99 a month
item.description: Amazon renamed its Prime Video ad-free add-on to Prime Video Ultra and raised it from $2.99 to $4.99 a month in the US.
